entities.name: RlmN
observations: The 348-aa query matches reviewed RlmN homologs at 45.6–46.2% identity with 97.7–98.9% query coverage and E-values ~1e-98 to 1e-101.
Pfam supports an RlmN_N domain at positions 5–58 and a Radical_SAM domain at positions 109–279.
Likely a dual-specificity RNA methyltransferase that modifies rRNA A2503 and tRNA A37; this substrate assignment is homology-based for the query.
Predicted molecular weight is 38.54 kDa and theoretical pI is 5.97.

entities.name: RlmN RNA methylation
observations: RlmN homologs catalyze SAM-dependent C2 methylation of adenosine 2503 in 23S rRNA and adenosine 37 in tRNA, with 5'-deoxyadenosine formation and reduced electron donor involvement.
The query’s exact substrate specificity remains inferred from homology rather than directly demonstrated.

entities.name: [4Fe-4S] cluster
observations: Reviewed RlmN homologs bind one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and an exchangeable SAM ligand.
The query contains a cysteine-rich region compatible with the RlmN radical-SAM cofactor architecture, but direct cluster binding was not experimentally measured here.

entities.name: Cytoplasm
observations: Reviewed RlmN homologs are annotated as cytoplasmic proteins.
Cytoplasmic localization is inferred for the query from close homolog annotations; the sequence lacks an obvious signal peptide or transmembrane segment.

entities.name: RNA modification
observations: RlmN activity is associated with rRNA base methylation and tRNA methylation, processes that contribute to RNA maturation and ribosome/translation function.
